name: models-query-400-capability
notes: GET /v1/models/query?capability=vision answers 400: the catalog records no per-model capability flags, so the filter cannot be honoured and must not silently return everything. The test additionally asserts the error message names capability. No upstream is called: the handler reads the local catalog, so recorded_response is nominal only.
